payload.name: Perceptual Fluency and Approach Action
payload.fact: Perceptual fluency facilitates approach-related movements when embedded in the context of affective decisions.
payload.boundary: The effect is absent when participants perform nonaffective classifications.

provenance.title: Easy moves: Perceptual fluency facilitates approach-related action.
provenance.quote_or_locus: Experiment 1 found faster approach movements (reaction times [RTs] to initiate arm flexion) to perceptually fluent stimuli when participants acted to rapidly classify stimuli as either "good" or "bad

provenance.title: Easy moves: Perceptual fluency facilitates approach-related action.
provenance.quote_or_locus: Experiment 2 eliminated this fluency effect on action when participants performed nonaffective classifications ("living" or "nonliving"), even though fluency robustly enhanced liking judgments
